name: Custom Shape 3-Layer Mirror Acrylic Reusable School Sign
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality transparent acrylic and mirror acrylic, offering a durable, stylish, and reusable display piece.
    - Designed with a 3-layer acrylic construction that creates depth, elegance, and a polished personalized look.
    - Product structure includes:
            +) Layer 1: Transparent Acrylic 3mm
            +) Layer 2: Transparent Acrylic 3mm
            +) Layer 3: Mirror Acrylic 3mm
    - The mirror acrylic layer adds a reflective decorative accent, while the transparent acrylic layers help create a clean and modern layered effect.
    - Reinforced for reusable use with one of the following options:
            +) Reinforced with Glue
            +) Reinforced with Disc Magnet – can be changed flexibly, maximum 10 magnet pairs
            +) Reinforced with Hook Loop Dots – can be changed flexibly
    - Available in Gold Mirror Acrylic and Silver Mirror Acrylic options.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Product size: 8 x 8 in ~ 20.32 x 20.32 cm
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - This product is made from 1-layer mirror acrylic and finished using precision laser cutting and engraving technology.
    - Product structure and printing details include:
            +) Layer 1: Transparent Acrylic – 2-sided printing
            +) Layer 2: Transparent Acrylic – 1-sided printing
            +) Layer 3: Mirror Acrylic – No printing
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a reusable school milestone sign and a personalized keepsake display.
    - Designed for first day of school, last day of school, classroom photo props, milestone pictures, and commemorative school memories.
    - Reusable sections allow information to be updated flexibly for repeated use over time.
    - Suitable for home photo sessions, school events, classroom decoration, and personalized gift display.
    - Can be displayed with the selected accessory option, including a penbox, no accessories, or an acrylic stand.
    - Perfect for creating memorable school photos while adding a cute and personalized decorative touch.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for kids, students, parents, teachers, and family members.
    - Perfect for back-to-school season, first day of school, last day of school, birthdays, and milestone celebrations.
    - Ideal for school photo props, classroom memories, and personalized keepsake collections.
    - A thoughtful gift for families who love documenting children’s school milestones in a fun and stylish way.
    - Great for home décor, classroom displays, and yearly school memory photos.
    - Adds a sweet, playful, and memorable touch to every school milestone 🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 3-Layer Mirror Acrylic Reusable School Sign

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
